baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed present verbs يُعَذِّبُ and يَرْحَمُ, the duplicated مَن يَشَاءُ construction, and the passive Godward close تُقْلَبُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The balanced active clauses differentiate treatment under one repeated volitional construction, while the passive plural close gathers every addressee into one Godward outcome. Discretion divides punishment from mercy, but return universalizes jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: The pain-and-penalty branch fixes the first verb's ordinary punitive pole.
The volition attached to bringing about a thing supplies the repeated discretionary operator.
The tenderness-and-benefaction branch supplies the opposed merciful pole.
Turning as departure and final outcome makes the closing direction a universal destination.

changed_reading.before: Punishment and mercy are two unrelated divine possibilities followed by a generic return.
changed_reading.after: They are a deliberate two-way sorting inside one unavoidable Godward jurisdiction and outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical branch range of ع ذ ب and ر ح م beneath the opposed verbs, followed by a passive change of orientation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-distant material reading places withholding or weaning opposite womb-like enclosure and growth. The final passive turning then marks transition between conditions rather than merely travel to a destination.

activation_trace.role: The withholding, prevention, and weaning branch recasts punishment as removal from a sustaining relation.
The womb as a protected site of growth gives mercy a generative and enclosing mechanism.
Turning something from one face or state to another supplies the transition between those conditions.

changed_reading.before: One person is hurt while another receives compassionate lenience.
changed_reading.after: One trajectory may be cut off or weaned while another is enclosed and grown, before all are turned into a new Godward condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive تُقْلَبُونَ with the fronted destination وَإِلَيْهِ and the heart/intellect range of ق ل ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because q-l-b names both the heart or understanding and a change from face to face, the closing passive can carry an interior overturning alongside objective return. The addressees do not control the final reorientation.

activation_trace.role: The heart, intellect, and inner faculty branch locates a possible object of the passive turning within the person.
The face-to-face reversal branch supplies the actual change of orientation imposed on that inner faculty.

changed_reading.before: You will simply be sent back to God.
changed_reading.after: Your orientation and possibly your heart's settled reading will be overturned toward God, as well as your destination being returned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening trials work like assays that expose the solidity of claimed trust, and 29:10 then depicts a person making human fitna like divine punishment. That comparison preserves overlap in pain while refusing a simple identity: testing pressure discloses, whereas the focus verb names the punitive pole after disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The explicit pain-and-penalty branch anchors the changed model in the focus verb.
Assaying metal or a person supplies a pressure that reveals composition rather than merely inflicts pain.
Disclosure to a knower makes the assay's functional result visible in the sequence.
Truth realized in deed supplies the stable result distinguished by the trial.
The affliction-and-torment branch explains why human pressure can be confused with punishment.
The punishment branch supplies the divine comparator that the sufferer wrongly collapses into human affliction.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 places trial before the disclosure of truthful and false claimants.
29:10 uses an explicit likeness construction between human fitna and God's punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, disclosure, realized truth, and the comparison; I infer an arrow from testing pressure to disclosure and reserve punishment for adjudicative pain. A live alternative is that some fitna is itself punitive, so the distinction is functional rather than absolute.

changed_reading.before: Any severe affliction can be read directly as the punishment named in 29:21.
changed_reading.after: The surah first distinguishes assay-like pressure that reveals allegiance from divine punishment, even though painful trial can resemble and overlap it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated work and recompense, the failed promise to carry another's errors, and the later taking of each by a fault make agency and consequence track their bearer. The focus will formula remains sovereign, but it now operates inside a field of owned action, nontransferable weight, and refusal to misplace consequence.

activation_trace.role: The volitional branch anchors the question of how discretionary treatment relates to responsibility.
Intentional action supplies the conduct to which the surrounding sequence repeatedly returns.
Reciprocating an act with its due consequence supplies an explicit correspondence mechanism.
Bearing moral weight supplies the promised transfer that the verse immediately denies.
Bearing one's own and added weights returns consequence to the claimant rather than transferring it away.
Fault or culpability supplies the stated attachment point for each taking.
Putting something outside its proper place supplies the denied divine misallocation and the affirmed self-misplacement.

structural_cues: 29:7 links good action to recompense, while 29:12-13 stages and rejects displaced burden-bearing.
29:40 opens with كُلًّا, attaches each taking with بِذَنبِهِ, then contrasts divine non-wronging with self-wronging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action, reciprocal consequence, failed burden transfer, fault, and non-misplacement; I infer that these constrain how the will formula is narrated, not that they compel divine will by an exhaustive rule. The alternative is looser juxtaposition in which responsibility and discretion remain unexplained beside each other.

changed_reading.before: Whom He wills can sound like an unpatterned allocation detached from each person's history.
changed_reading.after: The sovereign allocation is narrated alongside owned deeds and nontransferable burdens, with punishment explicitly protected from the charge of misplaced consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's kinship and womb ranges meet 29:8, where birth relations receive active goodness but not unlimited obedience, and Godward return closes the instruction. Mercy therefore preserves care while the final return reorders inherited authority.

activation_trace.role: The kinship branch makes family relation a live dimension of the focus mercy.
The womb branch supplies the bodily origin of the relation whose authority is being delimited.
Parenthood from birth supplies the concrete kin relation under instruction.
Doing good supplies the care retained toward parents despite the later boundary.
Submission and obedience supply the authority that is explicitly refused at the point of association.
Association with God supplies the limit beyond which kinship cannot command allegiance.
Return to the prior source makes Godward return the adjudicator of the family relation.

structural_cues: 29:8 holds parental goodness, refusal of obedience, and return to God in one uninterrupted sequence.
The focus repeats the same Godward destination after activating mercy's kinship and womb range.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies birth relation, retained goodness, bounded obedience, and return; I infer that the return adjudicates rather than abolishes kinship. The alternative is that the mercy root remains generic here and the family sequence only illustrates obedience.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is unqualified familial tenderness, and return is unrelated to present loyalties.
changed_reading.after: Mercy can preserve womb-born care while Godward return overturns the claim that inherited relationship deserves ultimate obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: A Godward return precedes the focus, then beginning, repetition, and a next origination immediately surround it, followed by the impossibility of escaping. The passive q-l-b close becomes an ontological reconfiguration into another emergence as well as a judicial destination.

activation_trace.role: Turning from one face or state to another anchors reconfiguration in the focus verb.
Turning as final outcome keeps the reconfiguration directed toward a destination.
Return to what one came from supplies the earlier Godward movement echoed by the focus close.
Beginning explicitly paired with repetition supplies the first half of a creation cycle.
Coming back after departure and repetition after a beginning supplies the cycle's second half.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies the next emergence into which the addressee may be turned.
Failure to outrun or escape closes off a merely optional journey away from that reorigination.

structural_cues: 29:19-22 places the focus exactly between beginning-and-repetition language and the denial of escape in earth or sky.
29:17 and 29:21 use passive plural Godward closures, but the latter intensifies return with q-l-b.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a return refrain, a begin-repeat-next-origination sequence, and nonescape; I infer that the focus passive turns persons through a change of created state. A live alternative is a purely judicial return with creation language serving only as proof of capability.

changed_reading.before: You are transported back to a tribunal after life.
changed_reading.after: You are unavoidably overturned through renewed origination into a Godward state and outcome, with judgment remaining part of that transformation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human agents choose burning as an imposed end, yet the intended victim is separated from the fire; later one messenger arrival carries both skin-opening good news and communal destruction, with a household extracted except for one remainder. The focus opposition and q-l-b close become a repeated reversal-and-separation operation within mixed scenes.

activation_trace.role: State reversal in the focus supplies the mechanism that changes intended outcomes.
Flame and fire supply the humanly intended terminal instrument.
Escape by separation reverses the intended effect of that fire.
News that opens the face with joy supplies the merciful side of one messenger arrival.
Falling into destruction supplies the punitive side announced in the same arrival.
Rescue by separation sorts a person and household out from the threatened collective.
A remainder left after others pass marks the exception that is not carried through the rescue.

structural_cues: 29:24 turns an attempted burning directly into rescue from the fire.
29:31-32 joins good news, destruction, rescue, and an exception within one messenger episode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed human intent and paired announcements with selective extraction; I infer that q-l-b names the recurrent reversal-and-sorting logic. The alternative is that these are examples of punishment and mercy without contributing a reversal sense to the focus close.

changed_reading.before: Punishment and mercy are static labels assigned to already separate groups.
changed_reading.after: They are enacted by overturning intended effects and separating different outcomes from within the same fire, arrival, or household.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah shows apparent insight coexisting with beautified deeds and blockage from a path, while clear signs can reside in breasts. Its later passive y-u-f-k depicts being turned away from orientation. The focus passive q-l-b can therefore be heard as a final counter-turn that exposes and reverses present inner misdirection.

activation_trace.role: The heart and understanding branch supplies the inner site whose present reading can be exposed.
Reversal from one face to another supplies the final counter-orientation.
Making a thing appear beautiful supplies the perceptual coating that stabilizes wrong action.
Turning aside and obstructing supplies the resulting displacement from the path.
Heart-sight makes the claim of being perceptive sharpen, rather than resolve, the paradox of misdirection.
The breast as an interior bodily site locates clear signs where orientation is formed.
Turning a thing away from its proper direction supplies a passive misorientation closely parallel to the focus passive.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance supplies the faculty that often fails to arrest the wrong turn.

structural_cues: 29:38 says they were perceptive while their deeds were beautified and they were blocked from the path.
The passive plurals تُقْلَبُونَ in 29:21 and يُؤْفَكُونَ in 29:61 create a marked directional parallel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner sight, beautification, obstruction, signs in breasts, and a later passive turning-away; I infer that the final passive is a corrective counter-turn. The alternative is that q-l-b only marks physical return and the passive parallel is rhetorical rather than mechanistic.

changed_reading.before: The final return changes location but leaves the person's prior perception outside the statement.
changed_reading.after: The final Godward turn also exposes and reverses an inward orientation presently capable of calling adornment insight and displacement direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs are housed in breasts, and the recited, delivered writing is then called sufficient and explicitly characterized as mercy and reminder. Mercy in the focus can thus be an enacted communicative process: something arrives, is followed in recitation, enters memory, and reorients its recipient.

activation_trace.role: Tenderness expressed as benefaction anchors mercy as an effective act rather than a private feeling.
The breast supplies the interior repository in which the delivered signs remain present.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency makes the recited sign adequate rather than merely supplementary.
Causing something to descend and reach a recipient supplies mercy's delivery vector.
Joined letters and written form supply the durable medium of the benefaction.
Following in sequence supplies recitation as repeated uptake of the delivered writing.
The context itself identifies the delivered and recited material with merciful benefaction.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the reactivating effect of textual mercy.

structural_cues: 29:49 locates clear signs in breasts before 29:51 calls the recited book sufficient.
In 29:51, mercy and reminder directly predicate the deictic complex centered on the delivered, recited book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, written form, following recitation, interior storage, mercy, and reminder; I infer a causal arrow from repeated uptake to merciful reorientation. The alternative is that mercy names possession of the book generally without specifying the mechanism of recitation.

changed_reading.before: He has mercy means an unpictured act of lenience or future acquittal.
changed_reading.after: He may enact mercy in the present by delivering a sufficient recited sign that remains in the breast and renews memory and orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The request to accelerate punishment meets a fixed term; arrival is then sudden, becomes an enclosure, covers from above and below, and is bodily tasted as the result of action. Punishment is not a momentary blow on demand but a withheld, timed transition into an all-encompassing experienced condition.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and restraint make delay a latent dimension of the focus root's branch range.
Pain and penalty keep the delayed process anchored in the ordinary punitive sense.
Acceleration supplies the demand for punishment to arrive before its set time.
A prescribed temporal limit blocks that demand and supplies controlled deferment.
Sudden surprise supplies the discontinuous transition when deferment ends.
Physical encirclement turns punishment from an incoming object into the subject's environment.
A covering that generally envelops supplies vertical and total exposure to that environment.
Experiencing something by tasting makes punishment bodily known rather than merely announced.
Intentional action supplies what the experienced condition is made to answer.

structural_cues: 29:53-55 moves in order from demanded haste, to appointed delay, to surprise, encirclement, vertical covering, and tasting.
The command ذُوقُوا is completed by مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ, linking experience back to ongoing action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal restraint, sudden arrival, spatial enclosure, bodily tasting, and action; I infer a process from deferment to immersive consequence. The alternative is that the spatial images only intensify severity and do not describe stages of punishment.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an immediate discrete strike that could arrive whenever challengers request it.
changed_reading.after: It is withheld to a measured term, then crosses a sudden threshold into an enclosing and bodily experienced consequence of action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's volitional formula recurs with provision, where spreading and constricting form an explicit measured pair; rain then restores life to dead earth. This direct syntactic echo makes willing look like calibrated governance across expansion, restriction, and renewal, while mercy's generative branch and punishment's withholding branch remain distinct possibilities within that governance.

activation_trace.role: The repeated willing branch supplies the focus formula whose mode is clarified by the later echo.
An apportioned grant supplies the governed resource distributed even to a creature that does not carry it.
Spreading and extension supply one motion of the later allocation pair.
The volitional occurrence within the supplied index bundle directly repeats the focus operator in the provision domain.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the counter-motion to expansion.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material input for the renewal that follows.
Earth becoming alive through rain and growth supplies a visible generative effect.
Loss of life supplies the prior condition that measured provision reverses.

structural_cues: 29:62 repeats لِمَن يَشَاءُ and immediately balances expansion with constriction.
29:60-63 moves from creatures unable to carry provision, through measured distribution, to rain-driven life after death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct will-formula echo, apportioned provision, expansion, constriction, water, and revival; I infer that this domain models the manner of divine willing as calibrated governance. The alternative is that provision is only another sovereign domain and should not qualify how punishment and mercy are heard.

changed_reading.before: The repeated will formula suggests unpredictable preference between two unrelated acts.
changed_reading.after: It suggests a governing agency that measures expansion and restriction and can use provision to move a dead condition into life, without reducing mercy or punishment to economics.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the final turn as a reversal of social topology, not only individual destination. It remains valid through q-l-b's reversal branch, r-h-m's kinship branch, and 29:25's explicit sequence from mutual affection to mutual repudiation, expulsion, and failed shelter. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory relational mechanism, not claim that every bond is condemned.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reversal range of تُقْلَبُونَ and the kinship range inside يَرْحَمُ.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face reversal supplies the change in how persons are related to one another.
Kinship and maintained relation supply the durable bond against which false affiliation is tested.
Mutual love supplies the worldly adhesive holding the association together.
Disavowal and detachment supply the first reversal of that adhesive.
Expulsion under anger supplies the bond's active inversion into mutual exclusion.
Joining a place of shelter supplies the terminal affiliation, here made punitive rather than protective.

changed_reading.before: Each person independently returns to God after receiving punishment or mercy.
changed_reading.after: Godward overturning can also invert a whole network: worldly mutual affection becomes reciprocal repudiation, while only a genuinely merciful kinship can remain shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it spatializes punishment and mercy as exposure versus enclosure. It remains anchored in the focus branches of uncovered ع ذ ب and womb-like ر ح م, then gains a coherent packet sequence through the weak adopted house, prepared rooms, and a protected sanctuary amid snatching. Downstream prose should label it a spatial analogy and never substitute it for the ordinary punishment and compassion senses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The uncovered-to-sky branch of ع ذ ب, the womb branch of ر ح م, and the destination force of تُقْلَبُونَ.

activation_trace.role: Exposure with no cover between a body and the sky supplies the spatial punitive pole.
The womb as a protected growth chamber supplies the spatial merciful pole.
Protective affiliation supplies what the adopted enclosure is expected to provide.
Dwelling and shelter supply the enclosure chosen as protection.
Loss of structural strength makes that shelter unable to bear its protective role.
Being installed in a dwelling supplies a durable counter-placement.
A garden hidden by growth supplies a living protected environment rather than a brittle shell.
Upper rooms supply the specified stable chambers of the merciful placement.
A protected spatial precinct supplies a present analogue of effective enclosure.
Rapid snatching outside the precinct supplies the exposure against which protection is visible.

changed_reading.before: Punishment hurts, mercy comforts, and return only names destination.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial analogy, punishment strips or fails cover, mercy places and grows within a durable enclosure, and final return reveals which shelter can actually hold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the sweet-water and abstention ranges inside the same root whose focus form ordinarily means punish. It remains visibly anchored there and is sharpened by explicit tasting, flowing rivers, and water reviving dead earth. Downstream prose must call it a material analogy about sustenance and deprivation, never a replacement gloss for يُعَذِّبُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sweet potable, abstention, and punitive branches of ع ذ ب set beside the womb branch of ر ح م.

activation_trace.role: Sweet and palatable water or food supplies the sustaining good whose absence can make deprivation intelligible.
Abstaining from food and drink supplies bodily deprivation within the root's non-punitive range.
Pain and penalty keep the material analogy attached to the actual focus sense.
The womb supplies a liquid-supported environment in which life is protected and grown.
Literal tasting gives the punitive experience a palate-based material interface.
A river cutting through earth with flowing water supplies sustained abundance in the merciful outcome.
Delivered water supplies the material carrier of renewed life.
Rain-grown life in the earth supplies the visible result of restored sustenance.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is external pain and mercy is affective pity.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, punishment can be imagined as forced tasting or deprivation of sustaining sweetness, while mercy restores a womb-like flow in which dead conditions become living.

strongest_changes: The 29:19-22 hinge changes return into unavoidable reorigination as well as judgment.
The opening assay sequence distinguishes revealing trial from punishment, while deed, burden, and fault cues prevent the will formula from reading as detached from responsibility.
The passive turning-away in 29:61 mirrors the focus passive and activates a final counter-turn of present inner misdirection.
The recited book explicitly makes mercy a delivered, sufficient, memory-renewing process in 29:49-51.
The 29:53-55 sequence makes punishment deferred, sudden, enclosing, bodily tasted, and answerable to action.
The direct will-formula echo in 29:62 frames willing through measured expansion and constriction, followed by water-driven revival.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context did not collapse the focus into one verdict. It made the same short opposition operate as assay and adjudication, responsibility without burden transfer, reorigination, reversal of intended outcomes, epistemic counter-turning, textual mercy, timed enclosure, and measured renewal; branch-distant womb, shelter, and water images remained useful only under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether q-l-b in the focus actively carries its heart-and-understanding range or only intensifies objective return.
How strongly the work, burden, and fault sequences constrain the repeated divine-will formula rather than simply standing beside it.
Whether the womb, enclosure, and palate-water mechanisms reflect deliberate activation or only productive lexical analogy.
Whether provision's direct will-formula echo describes the mode of punishment and mercy or merely supplies another domain of sovereignty.
